summary: Iteration 6 (Kelas + assignments-with-attachments + Informasi Sekolah + print Kartu Pelajar fix + demo-accounts-removed) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed (auth, demo-account rejection, classes CRUD + siswa scoping, assignment with subject+class_id+attachments, submission with attachments + grade, quiz with subject + answer-key stripping for siswa, settings school-info fields, admin creates kepsek). Frontend: verified via Playwright — Super Admin login OK, Coba Akun Demo buttons removed from Login page, siswa@sekolahku.id login now returns 401 (demo removed), /classes visible for admin with Buat Kelas Baru, class create+delete works, XI IPA 1 detail page renders with subject filter chips (all/Matematika/Fisika), new-assignment modal with subject select+file upload works, new-quiz modal with subject select works, siswa sees only own class (1 card, no create button), siswa submission with file+text succeeds, /school-info edit button shown for admin & hidden for siswa. Print fixes verified: Kelola Akun → Kartu opens modal showing full gradient KTP card (name/NISN/kelas/QR all visible, not blank), and /print-cards?kelas=XI IPA 1 renders the student ID card in the A4 grid area with the Print Sekarang button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1500 lines — split into routers (classes, assignments, submissions, quizzes, settings, files, exports, ppdb, chats). Recommended in previous iterations, still not done.

ClassDetail.jsx AttachmentChip builds URL from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /api/files/... but /api/files requires auth cookie/query. When rendered as <a href> in a new tab the cookie is sent (samesite=none, secure) — works, but consider adding ?auth=<token> fallback or noting cookie dependency for future.
PATCH /submissions/{sid}/grade takes grade as query param not body; slightly inconsistent with rest of API but functional.
No delete endpoint for assignments or quizzes — teachers cannot remove created items; enhancement suggestion.
